title: indigo_mount_synscan: a coordinates request admitted during park, home or auto home is overwritten with OK before it is refused
description:
Found on 2026-11-21 by the reviewer of ticket 3beb3554-f847-4155-b5e7-5bed700096f0 (closed, commit 296992891); present on master before that ticket. A MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES request admitted while a park, home or auto home runs claims nothing in on_change_request (only a sync, or a slew starting from idle, is claimed). The home finalizer (time-critical, due 0.2 s after the home handler) or the next poll can run before the queued GoTo handler (normal priority): it ends the motion, sets global_mode to IDLE and publishes OK over the request's BUSY; the handler then refuses with 'Mount is moving' after the motion has ended. The client sees BUSY, OK, ALERT. Observed as an intermittent failure of synscan_mount_goto_admitted_during_homing_is_refused in recorded runs (114/113, 117/116) until the test released its gate from the request's BUSY publication, which removed the accidental exposure but not the defect.

To do: reproduce deterministically in the simulator suite (hold the request's handler behind the finalizer), then either refuse the request before BUSY in on_change_request or claim every admitted request until its handler runs; all coordinates states through indigo_update_coordinates(), client targets never rewritten. Bump the driver version; recorded simulator run.
